hero.prompt: A wide painterly editorial illustration of a vast twilight sky over a quiet horizon. Most of the scene is held in deep indigo to near-black (#16112c fading to #0b0a1b), the indigo night still resting over the land. On one far edge of the horizon a warm Leo solar-gold dawn (#d4af6a) is just beginning to break, late, its glow cresting upward over the indigo as if a season is arriving after its time. A soft teal-and-gold nebula wash drifts through the upper sky. The light is symbolic and atmospheric, evoking Jupiter entering Leo for the July knockouts, gold cresting over indigo. ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces
